author: UFC / Zuffa LLC official fighter portrait (served by the ESPN CDN; photographer not named)
notes: Studio front headshot, neutral expression, shirtless, white background. Uploaded during UFC 333 fight week, so most likely shot in October 2026. Best frontal face reference. Hair is blow-dried straight with a heavy fringe here; it is naturally wavy in candid photos.

author: UFC / Zuffa LLC official fighter portrait (served by the ESPN CDN; photographer not named)
notes: Studio full body, slight three-quarter turn, black UFC kit shorts with grey scale pattern. Uploaded during UFC London fight week (March 2026). Best physique reference.

author: UFC / Zuffa LLC official fighter portrait (served by the ESPN CDN; photographer not named)
notes: Studio full body, three-quarter turn the other way, same kit. Uploaded October 2026.

author: UFC / Zuffa LLC (photographer not named on page; Khaleej Times credits face-off coverage to Nikita Kliukvin)
notes: UFC 333 ceremonial weigh-in face-off, Abu Dhabi (Evloev on the right, facing left). True LEFT profile of the face under a grey flat cap: nose line, chin and beard, left ear, hair curling out at the nape. Also the left shoulder, arm and back at fight weight, with no tattoos. Same file as alexander-volkanovski/ufc_2026-10_ufc333_faceoff_profile_wig.webp.

author: UFC (ceremonial weigh-in video still, via Cageside Press)
notes: UFC London ceremonial weigh-in face-off with Lerone Murphy (Evloev on the left, in a dark red and navy shirt). Three-quarter-to-profile view of his RIGHT side: natural wavy hair falling over the forehead, beard, right ear, nose shape. Video still, soft, warm arena light.

author: Chris Whiteoak / The National
notes: UFC 333 fight vs Volkanovski. Evloev at the left edge with his back and right side to camera, gloves up: back and arm musculature, hair texture when sweaty, white and grey patterned fight shorts with black UFC waistband.

author: Chris Whiteoak / The National
notes: UFC 333, Evloev on the bottom in Volkanovski's guard, seen from behind: full bare back (no tattoos), lats and spinal erectors, dark wavy hair, white/grey patterned VENUM fight shorts with a black waistband.

author: UFC (credited "Photos by UFC" on page)
notes: UFC 333 open workout at Yas Mall, Abu Dhabi: Evloev (left) throwing a high kick in a brown long-sleeve rash guard and beige shorts. Small in frame; useful for natural curly hair volume and side profile.
